name: VGMdb
overview: Adds support for VGMdb to music libraries. Can provide both images and metadata for artists and albums.
description: Adds support for VGMdb to music libraries. The API server URL is configurable, so it can be pointed at a self-hosted vgmdb instance instead of the unreachable public one.

versions.changelog: Identify by VGMdb album id now works; previously the id was ignored and the album name was searched instead.
Configurable API server URL via the plugin settings page.
